page.notes: Margin note marks: the q, *, r, f marks are clear; the mark before the Hebrew reference is read as ε with doubt, and the reference "Hebr.2.;8." is uncertain (possibly "Hebr.2.3,8."). The bullet mark before "Chrysost.l.3. de Sacerd." is uncertain, and the note itself was not transcribed, because it stands beside the line "An censes te" and I could not confirm its exact position. The "Sacr. X." note beside the heading is uncertain. The ⌣ marks before Ptolomæum, Archimedi, Alexandrum and Aristoteli are unclear printer's signs. The large initial D of "DEindèiure" is joined to the word as the rule requires. The "Aduer-" at the end of the page is a half word and is kept as printed. The Google digitiser stamp at lower right is excluded.
